structured.feedback: The description is about 200 words, uses clear Markdown subheadings and ends with a call to action. It has no links or invented quotes, and it leaves out the "doesn't work" complaints. Its claims come from the listing and are hedged with "designed to" and "results vary". The feature-versus-benefit split is partly blended and "fat-burning" is a bit strong, but both are minor.
